[SWS_CM_10494] Remote Access Control Activation
⌈
If IamModuleIn-
stantiation.remoteAccessControlEnabled is defined and is set to false, CM
shall perform no remote access control, i.e., no access to any service from a remote
subject shall be restricted because of missing ComGrants. If IamModuleInstanti-
ation is defined on the Machine and IamModuleInstantiation.remoteAccess-
ControlEnabled is not defined or is set to true, CM shall perform remote access
control.
⌋
